newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius and Indonesia sign investment agreement.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius and Indonesia sign investment agreement.

text.p: Mauritius and Indonesia signed an investment promotion and protection agreement on Wednesday to boost joint ventures.
Mauritian Finance Minister Vasant Bunwaree said the pact built on a double taxation agreement signed in December which he said he was sure would be ratified by Indonesia soon.

The new pact guarantees the transfer of returns, extends most favoured nation provisions to investments, provides compensation for losses in certain circumstances and protects investors against expropriation, the finance minister added.
